    def render(self, width=640, height=480, camera=-1):

    def save_final_state(self, path="/work/final_state.npz"):
        payload = {
            "qpos": self.data.qpos.copy(),
            "qvel": self.data.qvel.copy(),
            "ctrl": self.data.ctrl.copy(),
            "ctrl_trace": np.array(self._ctrl_trace, dtype=float).reshape(-1, self.model.nu),
            "initial_qpos": self._initial_qpos,
            "peg_pos": self.peg_position(),
            "time": self.data.time,
        }
        target = os.path.abspath(path)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(target), exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(delete=False, suffix=".npz", dir=os.path.dirname(target)) as tmp:
            tmp_path = tmp.name
        try:
            np.savez(tmp_path, **payload)
            os.replace(tmp_path, target)

import sim, mujoco, numpy as np
s=sim.Sim()
model, data = s.model, s.data
hand = mujoco.mj_name2id(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, 'hand')
arm_dofs = np.arange(7)

# initial orientation
R0 = data.xmat[hand].reshape(3,3).copy()

def fk(q):
    data.qpos[:7] = q
    data.qpos[7:9] = 0.04
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
    pos = data.xpos[hand].copy()
    R = data.xmat[hand].reshape(3,3).copy()
    return pos, R

def ik(target_pos, target_R=R0, q0=None, iters=200):
    if q0 is None:
        q = data.qpos[:7].copy()
    else:
        q = q0.copy()
    for i in range(iters):
        data.qpos[:7] = q
        data.qpos[7:9] = 0.04
        mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
        pos = data.xpos[hand].copy()
        R = data.xmat[hand].reshape(3,3).copy()
        err_p = target_pos - pos
        Rerr = R @ target_R.T
        rotvec = 0.5*np.array([Rerr[2,1]-Rerr[1,2], Rerr[0,2]-Rerr[2,0], Rerr[1,0]-Rerr[0,1]])
        err = np.hstack([err_p, 0.2*rotvec])
        jacp = np.zeros((3, model.nv))
        jacr = np.zeros((3, model.nv))
        mujoco.mj_jacBody(model, data, jacp, jacr, hand)
        J = np.vstack([jacp[:, arm_dofs], jacr[:, arm_dofs]])
        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J@J.T + 1e-4*np.eye(6), err)
        q = q + 0.4*dq
        q = np.clip(q, model.jnt_range[:7,0], model.jnt_range[:7,1])
        if np.linalg.norm(err_p) < 1e-3 and np.linalg.norm(rotvec) < 1e-3:
            break
    return q, np.linalg.norm(err_p), np.linalg.norm(rotvec)

for target in [np.array([0.35,-0.102,0.60]), np.array([0.42,-0.102,0.58]), np.array([0.45,-0.102,0.58])]:
    q, ep, er = ik(target)
    pos,_ = fk(q)
    print('target', target, 'sol q', np.round(q,3), 'pos', np.round(pos,3), 'err', ep, er)
